pain_point: No warehouse stock available in right size
headline_pain: Zero Stock in the West? Not True.
primary_text: "There's literally nothing available to buy in the size range we need in the west." The resale market is bare — we get it. But new supply is coming. Off-the-plan warehouses in Truganina are now available in the exact size range small businesses need. Stop competing for crumbs on the secondary market and secure a brand-new unit before construction completes. Minutes from Princes Freeway, West Gate Tunnel, and Port of Melbourne. Built for businesses that need functional space without paying for 2,000sqm they'll never use. Flexible layouts. Owner-occupier pricing.
description: New warehouse stock in Truganina — small-format units the resale market simply doesn't have.
